description: This file defines the TreeStringRenderer interface used in the OFBiz widget framework. It specifies methods for rendering various parts of a tree structure, such as nodes, labels, links, images, and the last element, as well as obtaining a ScreenStringRenderer instance.

classes.name: TreeStringRenderer
classes.description: An interface for rendering tree structures in the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a tree node.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a tree node.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders the label of a tree node.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a link within a tree node.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image within a tree node.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Renders the last element of a tree node.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Obtains a ScreenStringRenderer based on the provided context.
